create_qre_solver: create a QRE solver with configurable temperature, learning rates, and projection method
compute_qre_gradients: compute exploitability gradients for distribution and auxiliary variables given payoff matrices
run_mirror_descent: run entropic mirror descent update step on QRE solver parameters
run_euclidean_descent: run projected gradient descent with euclidean simplex projection on QRE solver parameters
compute_qre_exploitability: compute Shannon entropy regularized exploitability of a QRE policy estimate
